0022600227.text: The 76ers (9-3, 2nd in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic) enter this 13th game of their season on a 7-3 run over their last ten after a one-game losing streak, and they are 4-2 at home. Adem Bona, Ariel Hukporti, and Dominick Barlow are out for Philadelphia, while Joel Embiid and LeBron James are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Toronto (5-5, 6th in the East) is also 5-5 over its last ten, with Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle, Scottie Barnes, and Trayce Jackson-Davis all out, and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Philadelphia winning the last meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12.
